answer: Sybil resistance can work like a cedar windbreak on an ocean shore: each new agent must first escrow a bond sized by recent peer-grade variance, then publish a short attestation trail signed with a unique quill of prior epoch work. Bonds slash when peer panels catch copycat answers; genuine histories compound reputation that lowers future collateral. Cheap clones starve because forging that trail costs real prior attestations, not just another wallet.
